descriptionByLocale.en:
To strengthen our team in the crisis intervention ward with 16 treatment places, we are looking for you as of July 1, 2026 or by appointment. Your tasks will be:
• You competently implement the care process and promote the health and resources of patients
• You quickly build a sustainable relationship with patients. With a proactive attitude you ensure that a high quality service is always provided.
• You advise patients, their relatives, those treating them and those referring them
• You work in shifts Requirements:
• Qualified HF/FH nurse
• Ideally you have experience in acute psychiatry
• You are an enthusiastic, independent, responsible and initiative personality with a lot of humor
• Your professional and social skills, solution-oriented and comprehensive thinking and acting are what set you apart
• You enjoy interprofessional, cross-departmental collaboration
• You know how to keep a clear head in difficult situations and set priorities
• Very good manners and appreciative communication are important to you We offer: Our employees are the heart of our company. That's exactly why we offer you a lot: we strongly encourage further training. We also invest a lot in team cohesion and offer all of our teams access to the “Moodtalk” software, which strengthens team communication. We also offer attractive discounts on well-known brands such as Ikea, Zalando, Coop, Lidl and many more. Employees who commute to us by public transport receive an impressive eco-bonus at the end of the year. We also offer an attractive pension fund solution. We also promote work-life balance: We are always open to part-time work and offer the opportunity to buy a holiday.

Nous promouvons également l'équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie privée : nous sommes toujours ouverts au travail à temps partiel et offrons la possibilité d'acheter des vacances.
